item.title: Investigators hunt for what went wrong after cargo plane crash in Miami kills at least 5
item.description: Federal investigators are trying to determine what caused an Amazon cargo jet to barrel off a runway at Miami International Airport, killing at least five people and injuring five others as it struck vehicles and was engulfed in flames.
